purpose: Deny that something is especially true or a particular concern.
keywords: I do not have any particular plans tomorrow.
I do not particularly mind sitting somewhere else.
restrictions: Can sound dismissive depending on tone; not necessarily complete indifference.
mistake: Keep the negative predicate even when English uses “not particularly.”
